family_name: Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Rectangle - Capped

spec.description:
Autex Grid Ceiling Tiles - Frame/Vertex - Rectangle - Capped is a
high-performance 3D acoustic ceiling tile designed for standard 1200mm x 600mm
suspended grid systems. Available in architectural Frame (coffer) or faceted
Vertex styles, this capped version incorporates an integrated solid acoustic
backing layer that conceals the ceiling plenum. Made from 100% polyester fibre
with at least 60% recycled PET, it delivers enhanced sound absorption (NRC 0.60
- 0.85) and Group 1 fire performance.

install: Confirm 1200mm x 600mm suspended grid is properly suspended and square

Check
all tiles are from the same production batch before starting installation

Assemble tile and ensure the backing cap is securely locked onto the top of the
tile structure
Angle the assembled capped tile up through the grid aperture

Carefully lower the tile until its perimeter flanges rest flat on the T-bar
grid rails

Ensure uniform orientation and pattern alignment across adjacent
ceiling modules
selection_checklist:
Select between Frame (coffer) or
Vertex (faceted prism) style

Verify grid size is rectangular metric 1200mm
x 600mm

Confirm capped option is selected to ensure plenum concealment and
maximum NRC
Choose colour from Autex Cube palette

Confirm ceiling plenum
clearance accommodates tile depth (approx 80-100mm)
accessories: Standard two-way exposed ceiling grid (15mm or 24mm tee)
limitations:
Ensure plenum services (pipes, cables)
do not foul the 80-100mm depth of the capped tile

Not designed for exterior
or high-humidity wet area use

Do not install different batch numbers in the
same contiguous ceiling area
